findings.detail: Scale calibration is run after warm-up while the model remains in training mode. For the supported vq_type='ema', calling layer(residual) in calibrate_scales updates EMA cluster_size/embed_avg/embed as a side effect, so calibration is not a read-only scale-estimation pass and changes codebooks beyond the specified fixed scalar schedule. This can also introduce rank-local EMA state inconsistency in distributed training.
findings.reproduction: Set config.vq_type='ema', snapshot each layer's cluster_size/embed_avg/embed, invoke model.rq.calibrate_scales(encoded) with model.train(), and compare snapshots: the EMA buffers/codebooks change because calibrate_scales calls layer(residual) at line 282.
findings.correction: Estimate assignments without invoking the state-mutating training forward (e.g. temporarily switch VQ layers to eval and restore their prior mode, or implement a no-update nearest-assignment path), then derive residuals and scales without touching optimizer/codebook state. Ensure all ranks get identical frozen scales.
